## Posts {#posts style="display:none"}

```{=html}
<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function () {
  var items = [];
  document.querySelectorAll('div.quarto-post').forEach(function (post) {
    var h3   = post.querySelector('h3.listing-title');
    var link = post.querySelector('a.title-link');
    if (h3 && link) {
      items.push({ title: h3.textContent.trim(), url: link.getAttribute('href') });
    }
  });
  if (!items.length) return;

  var tocUl = document.querySelector('#TOC ul');
  if (!tocUl) return;
  tocUl.innerHTML = items.map(function (p) {
    return '<li class="nav-item toc-entry toc-h2">' +
           '<a class="nav-link" href="' + p.url + '">' + p.title + '</a>' +
           '</li>';
  }).join('');
});
</script>
```
